quarterly_data.quarter: TTM Technologies press release: TTM Technologies Announces $400 Million in Planned (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TTM announced a $400 million investment plan to expand capacity across four key facilities in China and its plant in Penang, Malaysia, incremental to the previously disclosed commitment to invest $1.2 billion through the 2025-2029 timeframe and, per TTM, buttressed by ongoing discussions with long-standing customer partners indicating expected demand increases. The investments are dedicated to AI infrastructure demand, primarily scaling TTM's advanced N+M asymmetrical interconnect manufacturing technology products for data center infrastructure providers, hyperscalers and networking customers, using a brownfield 'rapid ramp' approach (optimizing existing operational space and integrating new equipment) instead of greenfield construction. CEO Edwin Roks: 'The rapid growth in demand requires us to make rapid capacity increases across several of our facilities,' and TTM will continue to work with customers to define additional expansions as required. COO Jim Walsh: 'we believe we are shortening the time between investment and revenue.' TTM expects to give additional commentary on its Q3 2026 earnings call.
quarterly_data.figure: $400 million across four facilities in China and Penang, Malaysia; incremental to $1.2 billion through 2025-2029
